products.name: jasmine and neroli bloom showergel
products.description:
Step into a garden in full bloom. Palma Jasmine & Neroli Bloom pairs the soft, romantic sweetness of jasmine with the bright, sunlit freshness of neroli orange blossom. The result is a floral fragrance that feels elegant, uplifting and quietly indulgent.

The rich, silky lather cleanses gently and rinses away easily, leaving your skin soft, refreshed and delicately scented long after your shower. It’s a light floral that works just as well for a fresh start in the morning as it does for unwinding in the evening.

Our generous 1L bottle brings a touch of everyday luxury to your bathroom, and there’s plenty to share.
products.howToUse:
Squeeze a small amount of Palma Jasmine & Neroli Bloom Shower Gel into your palm, or onto a loofah or sponge.
Massage it gently over wet skin until it forms a rich, creamy lather.
Take a moment to breathe in the jasmine and neroli scent.
Rinse thoroughly with warm water.
Use daily for soft, fresh, delicately scented skin.
products.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Chloride, Glycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Citrus Aurantium Amara (Neroli) Flower Oil, Jasminum Officinale (Jasmine) Extract, Coco-Glucoside, Polyquaternium-7, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Linalool, Limonene, Benzyl Benzoate
products.notes:
Top notes: Neroli, bergamot, sweet orange
A bright, sunlit burst of citrus blossom that feels fresh and uplifting.

Heart notes: Jasmine, orange blossom, a hint of rose
A soft, romantic floral heart that’s elegant and feminine.

Base notes: White musk, soft amber, light woods
A warm, clean finish that keeps the scent on your skin after you shower.

Scent profile: Fresh floral · Elegant · Uplifting
